title: onosma alborosea var. sanguinolenta
intro: Onosma alborosea var. sanguinolenta, commonly known as Onosma, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. Onosma alborosea var. sanguinolenta has been reported to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing oxidative stress, pain, and inflammation. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
